title: GGUF-Metadata Prediction of Single-Sequence llama.cpp Throughput Across Three Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.14864v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We predict single-sequence model throughput from GGUF metadata using roofline-shaped predictors with quantization-specific scale factors fitted on reference models. The scored cohort comprises 318 phase-depth measurements from 53 host-file configurations on two Apple M4 Max systems and an NVIDIA RTX 5080. On host-specific held-out sets of four, five, and two configurations, an active-parameter decode model obtains 13.1%, 14.4%, and 36.1% mean absolute percentage error (MAPE), versus 49.4%, 55.3%, and 51.9% when charging total parameters. Leave-one-host-out coefficients fitted on the other two systems yield 11.6%, 16.8%, and 36.0% test MAPE. A low-bit model ladder changes ordering across runtime stacks. The P2 prefill baseline gives 18.7%, 22.2%, and 108.2% test MAPE. GGUF structure helps on all three systems, but fitted efficiencies are not universal.

translated_title: 基于GGUF元数据的三种系统上单序列llama.cpp吞吐量预测
translated_abstract: 我们使用基于屋顶线模型的预测器（结合在参考模型上拟合的量化特定缩放因子），从GGUF元数据预测单序列模型吞吐量。评分数据集包括在两台Apple M4 Max系统和一台NVIDIA RTX 5080上、53个主机-文件配置的318个阶段深度测量。在包含四个、五个和两个配置的各主机专属留出集上，活跃参数解码模型分别获得13.1%、14.4%和36.1%的平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE），而按总参数计费时误差为49.4%、55.3%和51.9%。在另外两个系统上拟合的留一主机系数产生了11.6%、16.8%和36.0%的测试MAPE。低比特模型阶梯在不同运行时栈之间改变了性能排序。P2预填充基线分别给出18.7%、22.2%和108.2%的测试MAPE。GGUF结构信息在所有三个系统上都有帮助，但拟合出的效率参数并不具备通用性。
tldr: 该论文提出利用GGUF元数据和基于屋顶线模型的预测器（结合量化特定缩放因子），在三种硬件系统上准确预测llama.cpp单序列推理吞吐量，并发现使用活跃参数而非总参数可将预测误差降低三至四倍。
en_tdlr: This paper predicts single-sequence llama.cpp inference throughput from GGUF metadata using roofline-shaped predictors with quantization-specific scale factors across three hardware systems, showing that using active parameters instead of total parameters reduces prediction error by three to four times.
